candidates.name: Datum height differences
verified_facts: OS describes legacy Liverpool-to-Newlyn datum differences as guide values rather than exact corrections.
Some offshore local datums are based on local mean-sea-level determinations and do not have a direct levelling link to ODN.
semantic_limits: Approximate legacy datum offsets cannot replace a contemporary vertical transformation or parcel-specific height survey.

candidates.name: OS Net RINEX data
verified_facts: OS Net RINEX provides GNSS reference-station data for post-processed positioning and is updated hourly.
OS describes nationwide coverage through roughly 120 base stations and centimetre-level precision for suitable post-processed positioning workflows.
semantic_limits: Reference-station RINEX data still requires correct GNSS processing, antenna modelling, transformation and local survey observations, and it is not parcel DTM or direct ground-elevation evidence.
